input: Task manifest with produced and needed deliverables
bottleneck: Implicit semantic handoffs hide dependencies and cycles
ai: MiniLM paraphrase linking between needs and other tasks outputs
deterministic: Cycle blocking and topological execution plan
distinctFrom: Unlike matching/taxonomy/gallery utilities, outputs a reviewed directed graph with acyclicity as an apply constraint, not category labels or resource assignments.

originalCollectionReadOnlyCheck.distinction: This utility uses actual local embeddings to reconcile explicit operational needs and deliverables, requires review, blocks cycles, and exports every supplied task in a validated execution order; it does not invent topic prerequisite trees.
